Location

A dungeon here (32911, 31599, 14), accessible through the Death Portal and the Old Masonry.

Behaviour

Fights in close combat. Every couple minutes she will teleport players into the middle of the room and after a few seconds she will cast an ultimate explosion around her (7sqm radius) that deals up to 2500 Death Damage. Lady Tenebris never retreats.
